“姐夫不信就算了。”林国强笑了笑，没有争辩。

孙建民放下茶杯，推了推眼镜，慢条斯理地说：“国强，我听说你跟家里闹分家了？还跟你大哥三弟争家产？”

这话问得直接，语气里带着一种“你一个老实人怎么突然变样了”的审视。

“不是争，是要个公平。”

林国强语气平淡，“分家产，兄弟姐妹之间应该一碗水端平，不能厚此薄彼。”

“公平？”刘胜利笑了，笑声里带着刺，“国强，你以前可不是这样的。

以前让你干啥你干啥，让你出钱你出钱，多好说话一个人。

现在怎么变了？是不是素梅教你的？”

赵素梅的脸一下子红了，正要开口，林国强按住了她的手。

“姐夫，没人教我，是我自己想明白了。”

他看着刘胜利，不卑不亢，“以前我太老实，什么都让、什么都给，结果自己家过得不像样子。

现在我学会了，该是我的，我一步不让。

不该我出的，一分没有。”

刘胜利的笑容僵了一下。

孙建民的眼镜片后面闪过一丝意外。

他没想到，这个以前在他面前连大气都不敢出的老实人，今天说话居然这么硬气。

“行了行了，今天是个好日子，说这些干啥。”

王桂兰从灶房端着一盘菜出来，打断了这场不太愉快的对话，“都坐都坐，马上开饭。”

开饭前，一个让林国强预料中的人出现了。

赵志军。

小舅子赵志军，二十岁，赵家唯一的儿子，被全家人捧在手心里长大的。

他个子不矮，一米七出头，但瘦得像根麻秆，脸上带着一种营养不良的苍白。

不是真的营养不良，是熬夜打牌、抽烟喝酒折腾出来的。

他穿着一件花衬衫，塞在一条喇叭裤里。

脚上是一双尖头皮鞋，头发抹了发胶，梳了个三七分，一走一晃，自以为很时髦。

“哟，三姐夫来了？”他一进门就看见了林国强，笑嘻嘻地走过来，一屁股坐在他旁边。

伸手就去拿桌上的烟，“大前门？好东西啊，二姐夫，你发财了？”

林国强没拦他，看着他把烟拆开，抽出一根叼在嘴上，又摸出一个打火机，“啪”地点着了。

"Brother-in-law, forget it if you don't believe me." Lin Guoqiang smiled and did not argue.

Sun Jianmin put down his tea cup, pushed up his glasses, and said slowly: "Guoqiang, I heard that you have separated from your family? Are you still fighting for the family property with your eldest brother and third brother?"

This question was asked directly, with a kind of scrutiny in his tone: "How come you, an honest person, suddenly changed?"

"It's not about fighting, it's about fairness."

Lin Guoqiang's tone was calm, "When dividing family property, brothers and sisters should treat each other equally and not favor one over the other."

"Fair?" Liu Shengli smiled, with a hint of thorn in his laughter, "Guoqiang, you were not like this before.

In the past, you did whatever you were asked to do, and you paid for it. What an easy person to talk to.

How has it changed now?Did Sumei teach you this?"

Zhao Sumei's face suddenly turned red, and when she was about to speak, Lin Guoqiang held her hand down.

"Brother-in-law, no one taught me, I figured it out myself."

He looked at Liu Shengli, neither humble nor arrogant, "I used to be too honest, giving in and giving everything, and as a result my family was not living well.

Now I have learned that it is mine and I will not give in.

I didn’t get a single point for anything I shouldn’t have paid."

Liu Shengli's smile froze.

A hint of surprise flashed behind Sun Jianmin's glasses.

He didn't expect that this honest man who didn't even dare to speak out in front of him before would actually speak so forcefully today.

"Okay, okay, today is a good day, why are you talking about this?"

Wang Guilan came out from the kitchen with a plate of dishes and interrupted this unpleasant conversation, "Everyone, sit down. Let's start dinner soon."

Before dinner started, a person that Lin Guoqiang expected appeared.

Zhao Zhijun.

Brother-in-law Zhao Zhijun, 20 years old, is the only son of the Zhao family. He has been raised in the hands of the whole family.

He was not short, just over 1.7 meters tall, but he was as thin as a hemp stalk, and his face looked pale and malnourished.

It's not really malnutrition, it's just the result of staying up late playing cards, smoking and drinking.

He wore a floral shirt tucked into a pair of bell-bottom pants.

On her feet were a pair of pointed leather shoes, her hair was slicked with gel and combed into a three-quarter part, and she walked around thinking she was very fashionable.

"Hey, the third brother-in-law is here?" As soon as he entered the door, he saw Lin Guoqiang, walked over with a smile, and sat down next to him.

He reached for the cigarette on the table and said, "Big front door? What a good thing. Second brother-in-law, are you rich?"

Lin Guoqiang didn't stop him and watched him take apart the cigarettes, take out one and hold it in his mouth, then took out a lighter and lit it with a "pop".
